question: In Windows 10, which of the following keyboard shortcuts is used to display and hide the desktop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Windows logo key + D.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The keyboard shortcut **"Windows logo key + D"** is used to **display and hide the desktop** in Windows 10.
 
• This allows users to** quickly minimize or restore all open windows.**
 
• This shortcut is really useful when you need to **access desktop files quickly**, or when you need to have a clear screen to start a presentation or a similar task.
 
• To note, pressing the keys again restores your applications to the state before you pressed the shortcut.
 
• This shortcut is one among many that are standard across Windows operating systems to help users carry out tasks more efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Windows logo key + H:** This shortcut opens the dictation tool in Windows 10. This allows you to input text through voice dictation instead of typing.
 
• **Windows logo key + C:** In earlier versions of Windows 10, this shortcut would open Cortana in listening mode, but after Cortana got decoupled from Search with the release of Windows 10, version 2004, it no longer works.
 
• **Windows logo key + G:** This keyboard shortcut opens the Xbox Game Bar in Windows 10. The Game Bar is a built-in tool that lets users access gaming-related features, record gameplay, take screenshots, and broadcast to Xbox Live.
